creative_intent: Normalize the user idea to prioritize a clean matte B4C technical ceramic material read, preserving the original shape and silhouette of a manufactured object with minimal transformation, while maintaining a material-only scope.

must_have: evidence of original shape and contours
exactly one manufactured object as the clear subject
visible contour evidence such as edge, rim, bevel, seam, or curvature
material visibly attached to the object, not floating as texture

composition.framing: tight, focused on the object to emphasize material
composition.camera: neutral, eye-level, to clearly present the object

constraints: even illumination to highlight material properties
no specular highlights that obscure the matte finish
color must remain subordinate to material identity
color must follow form then material, never override them
no flat color, always material texture variation
pure white and pure black are forbidden
ceramic off-white must stay warm and broken, never sterile pure white
charcoal black must keep temperature variation, never dead pure black
restrained crimson only in seams, cores, or controlled heat accents
muted earth support only, low saturation material support tones

core_risks: Drift towards abstract composition or texture-only output
Loss of clear manufactured object identity
Unwanted material reads (e.g., glossy plastic, plaster)
Failure to preserve original shape and silhouette
material misread as plaster, stone, or glossy plastic
anti_drift_rules: Ensure material is the primary focus without losing object read
No atmospheric or textural dominance over form
always preserve one clearly readable manufactured object
do not let texture or atmosphere become the subject
keep material identity locked and explicit
form -> material -> color priority is mandatory
do not allow neon, pure white, pure black, or plastic-clean RGB drift
crimson may appear only as restrained seam/core accent when applicable
success_criteria: Immediate readability of a clean matte B4C technical ceramic
Clear identification of a single, distinct manufactured object
Preservation of the object's original shape and silhouette
Absence of any forbidden material reads
image does not collapse into abstract texture or atmosphere
color feels subtractive and pigment-like, never RGB-clean
shadow mass dominates and color remains materially grounded
direction_summary: Focus on rendering a single, clearly identifiable manufactured object made of clean matte B4C technical ceramic, ensuring its original shape and silhouette are perfectly preserved within a material-only scope.
